SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
ORDER BY sp.power_name
LIMIT 5

SELECT g.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS male_heroes, COUNT(DISTINCT sp.id) AS distinct_powers
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
GROUP BY g.gender
